question: Which mineral ore's deposits are formed by the decomposition of a wide variety of rocks rich in aluminium silicates ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bauxite.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bauxite**

 
 
• Although it is also utilized as an **industrial mineral**, bauxite is primarily a** metallic mineral**. It is the only** ore** utilized in the production of **aluminium** on a large scale.
